budgets.hint: Rewrite it: it holds the next action only.
Ten questions at most. Ask the director to answer some before adding more.
One line per dead end: tried, why it failed, do instead.
One line per decision, with a link to the full record.
Finished steps leave the queue; their record is the commit.
One line per row: path, purpose, open it when. Detail goes in the module's CLAUDE.md.
Move file-specific rules into path-scoped .claude/rules/ files.
Move closed material to docs/archive/, or add a size-reason: line at the top saying why it must be long.
